memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"Now Jethro, the priest of Midian and father-in-law of Moses, heard of everything
God had done for Moses and for his people Israel, and how the LORD had brought
Israel out of Egypt." - Ex 18:1 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
News travels. Jethro is far away in Midian, and yet he hears everything.

That is worth noticing. God had said the nations would hear (Ex 15:14), and here
is the first person we see hearing. What God does in one place does not stay in
that place.

Notice how the verse describes what he heard: "everything God had done for Moses
and for his people." Not everything Moses achieved. The report that reached
Midian gave the credit correctly.

Notice also who Jethro is. A priest of Midian, an outsider to Israel, a man from
a different people with a different religious background. He is Moses'
father-in-law, the man who gave him work and a family during forty years of
obscurity. When Moses had nothing and no future, Jethro took him in.

God had been placing people around Moses long before Moses knew he would need
them.

There are people in your life right now who are part of God's provision for you,
and you may not recognise it yet. And you may be that person for someone else
without knowing it.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Who took you in during a season when you had nothing to offer?
2. What is being reported about God through your life?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Father, thank You for the people You placed in my life before I knew I needed
them. Let the story of what You have done travel through me. Amen.
